rules.direction: after minus same-year original and baseline10
rules.annual_conflict: report any mixed signs; do not accept on mean alone
rules.monthly: daily means, annualized excess x252; month-first turnover retains previous trading day; never average monthly scores into annual score
rules.diagnostics: official Top includes non-limit-up missing-label rows; price-valid turnover diagnostic only; monthly counts weighted by Top membership
rules.decision: no automatic replacement, ranking or extra runs; improvement/degradation does not establish absence/presence of overfitting
rules.intervals: descriptive annual/monthly comparisons only; no significance or equivalence claim; historical selection bias is not quantified
